criteriaPassing.method: criteria (acceptance-criteria) from docs/ba/user-stories.md with status PASS; a criterion passes only when ≥1 executed JUnit test names its ID and none fails

criteriaFailing.method: criteria (acceptance-criteria) from docs/ba/user-stories.md with ≥1 failing test; a criterion passes only when ≥1 executed JUnit test names its ID and none fails

criteriaUnverified.method: criteria (acceptance-criteria) from docs/ba/user-stories.md with no executed test; a criterion passes only when ≥1 executed JUnit test names its ID and none fails

criteriaDeferred.method: criteria (acceptance-criteria) from docs/ba/user-stories.md deferred in quality-gate.json → trace.allowUntested; a criterion passes only when ≥1 executed JUnit test names its ID and none fails

testsPassed.method: JUnit test cases naming ≥1 criterion that passed

testsFailed.method: JUnit test cases naming ≥1 criterion that failed

completionPercent.method: criteriaPassing / criteriaTotal × 100 (deferred and unverified criteria count as not complete)

agentTasks.method: distinct tasks with a task-start event (validate.mjs task-start)

agentTasksWithoutCorrection.method: tasks whose last task-end succeeded (diff-guard) and that no corrective event names

items.summary: Kick-off: BentoMinder scaffolded from app-boilerplate v0.5.0 (content-app), local git only, no push or deploy without PO approval
PO asked to delegate requirements, architecture and design proposals before BR-table approval; framework order (BR yes before dispatch) relaxed for proposal-only work
Orchestrator set the new repo's local git identity by hand (preflight warning; framework forbids global config)
Orchestrator split a merged model-card quote and added the Android 14 exact-alarm citation after verification
PO approved the architecture (ADR 001-005 direction) and the BR table BR-01..BR-27 at kick-off
PO: design token surface-1 (light page background) changed from cream to pure white, no yellow tint
PO accepted the design direction: Monday week start (Sunday setting), Sat blue / Sun red numbers, Zen Maru Gothic + system fonts, no tab bar
PO: AI menu import used from Japan only; Gemini free tier, no billing account
PO accepted all 15 BA open-question defaults OQ-01..OQ-15
H1: BR-06/09/10 restated with resolved R-1/R-3 rules; BR-14 tightened to https-only import URLs (security default)
H1 rulings on 8 QA blockers (B1 B2 B4 B5 B6 B7 B10 B14) and 5 non-blocking items, logged in PLAN section 7
H1 follow-ups: bento-day refresh not flagged, dislike wins ties, dormant decisions on no-lunch dates, KEEP_PLAN acknowledgement
Orchestrator overruled BA default OQ-16: related dictionary ids (dish/ingredient, parent/child) count as one food in D/L
Orchestrator narrowed the BA's transitive food-collapse wording: dish merges only with its defining ingredient; no chaining across items
H1 closing rulings A57 S10 O-3 U5 RU1 N3 and AC15 precedence, logged in PLAN section 7
PO approved committing H1 and H2 locally and starting M0
Orchestrator error: task-start --allow was given comma lists (needs one flag per glob); diff-guard runs falsely failed. Re-run correctly: 86 files all allowed
Developer could not write the env example file: blocked by the secrets deny rule; surfaced to the PO, not bypassed
Orchestrator added .gitattributes (eol=lf): CRLF checkout of merged M0 broke a Vitest import; gate green after
PO will write the env example file personally (agents are blocked by the secrets rule); M1 approved to start
M1 prep: OQ-21..26 defaults accepted; export without exportedAt; rule-id renames for the developer
PO: from now on developer and QA agents run on Sonnet; orchestrator, BA and verifier stay on Opus. Running M1 developer finishes on Opus
Orchestrator excluded QA's own e2e suite from the main Playwright config (it needs the proxy and its own config); main e2e back to 24 passing
PO approved committing M1 locally and running the M1 fix round in parallel with M2 prep
Orchestrator miss: committed e9ae2e9 without re-running the gate after QA added its suite (24 lint errors, 1 type error); found and fixed in the M1 fix round
Developer relaxed two lint rules for QA test files only to unblock the gate; accepted temporarily, QA to clean up and restore in M2
PO approved committing the M1 fixes and M2 prep, and starting M2 with recipe research in parallel
Research: unlabelled processed foods keep allergenInfo unknown (R-3) instead of skipping; stated source times win; House curry label checked for cashew
PO: cite manufacturer labels for processed foods (ham, sausage, tuna, cheese, miso, bread) so allergen filtering is precise instead of unknown
Orchestrator relaxed recipe-possible-allergens: varies-by-product may cite a label with no allergens, so processed foods are never recorded as known-none (verifier finding)
PO approved committing main locally before the break; the M2 branch stays unmerged
Lean orchestration applied on branch chore/lean-orchestration: Sonnet default, Opus only with PO approval, BA scope narrowed, 2-cycle fix limit; baseline recorded
PO approved merge of chore/lean-orchestration into main (7a70e23, local, no push)
PO approved the MVP milestone for the evidence package

testsPassed.method: JUnit test cases without failure, error or skipped

testsFailed.method: JUnit test cases with a failure or error

defectsFound.method: distinct defect IDs (cumulative to collection; latest state per defect ID)

P1.method: distinct P1 defect IDs (cumulative to collection; latest state per defect ID)

P2.method: distinct P2 defect IDs (cumulative to collection; latest state per defect ID)

P3.method: distinct P3 defect IDs (cumulative to collection; latest state per defect ID)

P4.method: distinct P4 defect IDs (cumulative to collection; latest state per defect ID)

defectsFixed.method: defects whose latest state is fixed (cumulative to collection; latest state per defect ID)

defectsDeferred.method: defects whose latest state is deferred (cumulative to collection; latest state per defect ID)

defectsOpen.method: defects whose latest state is found (cumulative to collection; latest state per defect ID)

regressionFailures.method: tests passing in the previous milestone package and failing now
regressionFailures.reason: no earlier frozen milestone package to compare with

verificationsPassed.method: verification events with outcome success in the window

verificationsFailed.method: verification events with outcome failure in the window

requirementCoveragePercent.method: criteria with ≥1 executed test / criteriaTotal × 100 (requirement coverage, not code coverage)

codeCoveragePercent.method: total.lines.pct from the coverage summary (which code ran, not whether it is correct)

detectionEffectiveness.reason: no seeded-defect baseline (quality-gate.json → evidence.seededDefects); without one, detection effectiveness cannot be measured

totalTokens.method: sum of input + output tokens over model usage entries (cache tokens are reported separately)

cacheTokens.method: sum of cache-write + cache-read input tokens over model usage entries

apiCostUsd.reason: no list price configured for claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5 (quality-gate.json → evidence.pricing); the subscription itself is billed separately and this is not zero-cost execution

infrastructureCostUsd.reason: the usage log covers model tokens only; supply infrastructure costs with --usage

reworkMinutes.method: sum of minutes on interruption/resume events that recorded them

recoveryTestsPassed.method: controlled recovery tests (fresh session restored state from CATCH-UP.md) that succeeded

releaseRef.method: git tag pointing at the measured commit
releaseRef.reason: no tag points at the measured commit

conclusion.method: latest .github/workflows/ci.yml run for the commit (GitHub Actions)
latest .github/workflows/deploy.yml run for the commit (GitHub Actions)

liveUrl.method: configured live URL, fetched during collection

smokeTest.method: HTTP 200 and the page contains the configured marker

milestoneComplete.reason: functional, QA or delivery evidence is unverified

limitations: 3 acceptance criteria have tests that name only their story, not the AC ID; they stay unverified until a test names the AC.
Intervention, defect and recovery counts come from the project event log and are only as complete as that log.
Code coverage shows which lines ran during tests; it is not evidence that the code has no defects.

Token usage comes from Claude Code session logs snapshotted on the machines that ran this project (hour buckets; the boundary hour belongs to the earlier milestone). Sessions on other machines or in the cloud are missing unless they were snapshotted there.

Development cost is incomplete: no list price configured for claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5 (quality-gate.json → evidence.pricing); the subscription itself is billed separately and this is not zero-cost execution.
